period_note: Year-end position sourced from a later annual report's own multi-year 'Key Financial Information' summary table (audited), Solo basis. The FY2011 annual report's own text extract (pubalibank-annual-report-2011.txt) has OCR corruption in its own 'Key Financials' table (e.g. its 2011 column shows Total Advances as a garbled 106,229.49 and other digits shifted), so the FY2014 report's clean comparative column was used instead. This is independently corroborated: the FY2012 and FY2013 reports' own (clean) 'Key Financials' tables report identical figures for 2011 (Total Deposits 123,805.97, Total Advances 106,329.63, Total Assets 157,153.71) — an exact 3-way match. profit_before_tax and gross_profit apply this dataset's resolution of a systematic mislabeling: the FY2012/FY2013 reports' own abbreviated tables label pre-PROVISION operating profit as 'Pre-tax Profit' (showing 5,480.22 for FY2011), while the fuller FY2014 table separates 'Operating profit' (5,480.22, matching those reports) from the true post-provision 'Profit before tax' (5,410.22). This resolution is proven for FY2012-2014 by an exact match against those years' own Value Added Statement tax reconciliation (see sources.json); FY2011 is resolved the same way for pattern-consistency, though its own effective tax rate (42.7% using 5,480.22, vs 42.0% using 5,410.22) does not as sharply discriminate between the two candidates as FY2012's does. total_liabilities is calculated as total_assets minus total_equity (not separately given in the summary table for this year). DATA QUALITY FLAG: this table's own reported car_pct (11.56%) does not reconcile with its own actual_capital/RWA figures (17,976.71 / 132,581.60 = 13.56%), a ~2 percentage-point internal inconsistency unique to the FY2011 column (FY2012-2014 all reconcile exactly). The literal reported 11.56% is recorded here rather than the recomputed 13.56%, since — unlike the profit-before-tax case — there is no independent third source (e.g. a Value Added Statement) to determine which of RWA/actual-capital/CAR% is the erroneous figure in this column.
